verses.1: And when Sanbalat, Tobiah, the Ammonites, the Canaanites, and the Ashdodites heard that the battles around Jerusalem had begun to end, they became very worried.
verses.2: And they all joined together to go and fight in Jerusalem, and to bring about victory for them.
verses.3: And we shall pray to our God, and stand vigil over them day and night against them.
verses.4: And Yehuda said, “The strength of the branches and leaves is too great; we cannot bear to plant them in this world.”
verses.5: And they said, “Our enemies do not know nor fear when we come to their homes. They will kill us and take what belongs to us.”
verses.6: And when the Jews who lived near them arrived, they said to us, “Twelve times over all the places where they would return to us.”
verses.7: And I will stand from beneath the ruins in the fields, and I will arrange the people in their families, with their houses, their crops, and their shelters.
verses.8: And I will stand up and say to the nobles and rulers and to all the people: Do not be afraid of them. Remember the great and glorious God. Fight against your own brothers, sons, daughters, and grandchildren.
verses.9: And when our enemies heard this, they knew that God had given them a plan. So we all went back to our homes, each doing what was required of us.
verses.10: And from that day on, half of the young men were working in the fields. The other half were responsible for handling the tools and equipment needed for farming. They also had to carry the tools and materials necessary for farming.
verses.11: Those who build in the house and those who carry things on the stretcher are both involved in work. One hand is used for working, while the other hand is used to hold or carry things.
verses.12: And those who build a house will be forbidden from receiving any gifts or rewards for their efforts. They will also be punished in the wilderness.
verses.13: And he said to the workers and to those who were responsible for various tasks, “We must leave this place. We will be separated from each other, far apart from one another.”
verses.14: In that place where you will hear the voice of the trumpet, then come to us, our gods. They will fight for us.
verses.15: And we work hard in our tasks; half of us keep the food from the black altars until the stars appear again.
verses.16: Even at that time, I said to the people, “A man and a boy shall work within Jerusalem. They will have protection during the night, and they will be able to work during the day.”
verses.17: And I, along with my brothers and young men, and the people who serve me, are not weak in our faith. No one who is sent by the sea can bring us down.
